expressions.cn: 你可以帮我一下吗？ (Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ yīxià ma?)

expressions.en: Could you repeat that, please? / Pardon?
expressions.cn: 你可以再说一遍吗？ (Nǐ kěyǐ zài shuō yī biàn ma?)
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah anda mengulanginya? / Maaf, boleh terangkan semula?
Terima kasih banyak-banyak. / Saya amat menghargainya.

expressions.en: Is it ready? / Is it available?
expressions.cn: 准备好了吗？ (Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?) / 有吗？ (Yǒu ma?)
expressions.bm_formal: Adakah ia sudah siap? / Adakah ia tersedia?

work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing a new project deadline. You need to ask a colleague for help with a complex task and confirm if a report is ready.

life.scenario: You are at a local mamak stall, ordering food. You need to ask for a clarification on an item, express thanks, and apologize if you made a mistake.

tech.scenario: You are trying to troubleshoot an internet connection issue with a friend over the phone. You need to understand their instructions, ask them to repeat if unclear, and confirm if a software update is complete.
